itinerary.summary: Experience the best of Rome with this mixed-style 2-day itinerary, blending ancient wonders, artistic masterpieces, charming neighborhoods, and delicious Roman cuisine, all within a comfortable budget.

entries.name: Breakfast at Antico Caffè Greco
entries.description: Start your day with a classic Italian breakfast at one of Rome's oldest and most famous cafes, enjoying a cappuccino and a cornetto in an elegant setting. While a bit of a splurge, it's an iconic Roman experience.
entries.address: Via dei Condotti, 86, 00187 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill
entries.description: Step back in time to Ancient Rome. Explore the iconic Colosseum, imagine gladiatorial contests, then wander through the sprawling ruins of the Roman Forum and the imperial palaces on Palatine Hill. Purchase the 'Super Pass' ticket online in advance to save time and ensure entry. The standard ticket is €18 and includes all three sites.
entries.address: Piazza del Colosseo, 1, 00184 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Lunch at Taverna Romana
entries.description: Enjoy an authentic Roman lunch at this traditional trattoria, known for its classic pasta dishes like Cacio e Pepe or Amatriciana, located conveniently close to the Colosseum area.
entries.address: Via della Madonna dei Monti, 79, 00184 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Pantheon
entries.description: Visit the remarkably preserved ancient Roman temple, now a church, marveling at its impressive dome and oculus. Entry is €5 before July 1, 2026. Booking is recommended, especially for weekend visits.
entries.address: Piazza della Rotonda, 00186 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Trevi Fountain
entries.description: Toss a coin into the iconic Trevi Fountain to ensure your return to Rome. Be prepared for crowds, but take your time to admire the Baroque masterpiece.
entries.address: Piazza di Trevi, 00187 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Spanish Steps
entries.description: Stroll to the Spanish Steps, a grand Baroque staircase connecting Piazza di Spagna with the Trinità dei Monti church. Enjoy the bustling atmosphere and the views from the top.
entries.address: Piazza di Spagna, 00187 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Gelato at Giolitti
entries.description: Indulge in some of Rome's best gelato at Giolitti, one of the city's oldest and most beloved gelaterias. Try classic flavors like pistachio or stracciatella.
entries.address: Via degli Uffici del Vicario, 40, 00186 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Public Transport 48-hour Pass
entries.description: Purchase a 48-hour public transport pass for convenient travel around Rome. This pass costs €15 and covers buses, trams, and metro.

entries.name: Dinner at Naumachia
entries.description: Savor a delightful dinner at Naumachia, a highly-rated restaurant near the Colosseum known for its excellent Roman cuisine and pleasant ambiance.
entries.address: Via Celio Vibenna, 7, 00184 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Breakfast near Vatican
entries.description: Grab a quick and affordable Italian breakfast at a local bar or cafe near the Vatican, fueling up before a busy morning of sightseeing.
entries.address: Via Leone IV, 60, 00192 Roma RM, Italy (Example: Caffè Vaticano)

entries.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
entries.description: Immerse yourself in the vast art collections of the Vatican Museums, culminating in Michelangelo's breathtaking Sistine Chapel. Book your 'skip-the-line' tickets online for €25 to avoid long queues.
entries.address: Viale Vaticano, 00165 Città del Vaticano, Vatican City

entries.name: St. Peter's Basilica
entries.description: After the Vatican Museums, visit St. Peter's Basilica, one of the largest churches in the world. Entry is free, but expect security lines. Admire Michelangelo's Pietà and the grand dome.
entries.address: Piazza San Pietro, 00120 Città del Vaticano, Vatican City

entries.name: Lunch at 200 Gradi
entries.description: Enjoy a casual and delicious lunch at 200 Gradi, a popular spot near the Vatican known for its gourmet sandwiches and fresh ingredients.
entries.address: Piazza del Risorgimento, 17A, 00192 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
entries.description: Walk along the Tiber River to Castel Sant'Angelo, Hadrian's ancient mausoleum turned papal fortress. Explore its history and enjoy panoramic views of Rome. Entry is €16.

entries.name: Ponte Sant'Angelo and Tiber River Walk
entries.description: Admire the beautiful angels on Ponte Sant'Angelo, the bridge leading to the castle, and take a leisurely stroll along the Tiber River, enjoying the evening atmosphere.

entries.name: Explore Trastevere
entries.description: Cross into the charming Trastevere neighborhood, known for its narrow cobblestone streets, artisan shops, and lively atmosphere. Perfect for an evening wander.

entries.name: Dinner at Tonnarello
entries.description: Experience authentic Roman dining in Trastevere at Tonnarello, a popular restaurant famous for its traditional pasta dishes and vibrant atmosphere.
entries.address: Via della Paglia, 1/2/3, 00153 Roma RM, Italy

entries.name: Evening Gelato in Trastevere
entries.description: Cap off your Roman adventure with a final gelato from a highly-rated spot in Trastevere, such as Otaleg or Fior di Luna, known for their artisanal flavors.
entries.address: Via di San Cosimato, 14a, 00153 Roma RM, Italy (Example: Otaleg)
